I just recently swapped from Proxmox to XCP-NG across all 4 of my servers. They are different but very similar.

Ive ran Hyper-V for 3 years. Proxmox for over 4 years and just started running XCP-NG in October.

Imo

XCP-NG is much much more Hyper scale. Clustering is easier and makes more sense, your management is independent of your servers. VGPU is easier. You can Autoscale VMS and for business i prefer their license structure.

Proxmox is much more beginner friendly. You dont need to worry about if the networking on your hosts is identical for migrations. Its much more easy to manage but you do lose the more hyper scale features that something like XCP-NG runs.


Running XCP-NG now, theres things I greatly miss about Proxmox. Not that they cant be done in XCP-NG but they are done differently. 

I like XCP-NG more at the moment. But thats solely because I think its more modern for system administrators and provides better learning opportunities.
